content: “Babgan, gwenadgan, nue be an-itomalo, an na san-bendakega an ibmar sogoed.”
Dulemar Pablo ega Hebreo-gayaba sunmakar itoarmargu, bur bule bogidik ambikusmalad. Pablo weyob sogded:

“An Judío-dule gued. Cilicia-yargi, Tarso-neggweburgi an gwalulesad. Degi-inigwele, wegi Jerusalénʼgi an dungusad, odurdaked-saila-dummad-Gamalielʼye-nugadi, an-odurdakedga gusad. A-dule, anmar-dadgan-igar-maidba nue an-odurdaksad. Igi bemar emi-ibagi dulemar Bab-Igargi yolebisur be abemala, an deyobi, dulemar Bab-Igar-Maidgi yolebisur an abedii gusmogad.
Iduardi, Jesús-igarba-nanaimalad-oburgwegala baregindii an gusad. Omegan, degi, machergan esgaryase-metega ebipidii an nanasad.

Deyob an gudigusadi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadi, bela Judío-girmar-dummagana nue wismalad. Ar amar anga garda uksagusmarbalid, adi, gwenadgan-Judíoʼmar-Damascoʼgi-bukmaladga ukegar. Adi, degidbali, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-gaegar. Degisoggu, dulemar-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-gaega, degi, sabsur-odurdakbaliga, geb Jerusalénʼse-sedagega Damascoʼse an nadegusad.”
Pablo, Bab-Jesús-abingasgusadgi sunmaksad
Pablo sogdebalid: “Igarba an nadapgu, bato Damasco-neggwebur-walikgusgu, nega-yorukudsik, ukiar nibneggi binnasur angi gwallu-mee ganonikid.
Degidbali, napase an aimukuded. Agi gayaburba gole, anga soge an itosad: ‘Saulo, Saulo, ¿Ibiga be an-baregindii?’
”Abin an sogded: ‘¿Dummad, be doasunna?’ A-dule an-abin imaksad: ‘Ani an Jesús-Nazaretʼginedid. Ar ani be an-baregindiid.’
Ar anba-nadapmaladdi gwallu-mee-gasad nue daksamalad, degi, nue gwayismarbalid, degi-inigwele, dule-anga-ibmar-sogsaddi aku itosmalad.
”Geb ega an sogdesunnad: ‘Degite, Dummad, ¿ibu imakbi be an-abesunna?’ Degi, Dummad-Jesús weyob anga sokalid: ‘Be gwisgu, Damasco-neggweburse be nae, agi be-ibmar-imakoye-soglesad, bega soglegoed.’
Geb an-sordamar argangi-ise-sear Damasco-neggweburse an-sesmalad. Ar ade, gwallu-mee-angi-gasadbali, ibya-sobmor an gusad, geg bar-atake an naded.
”Damascoʼgi dule-wargwen, Ananíasʼye-nugad, mai-gusad. A-dulede, Moisés-Igar-Maidba nue nanadimogad-duled, degine, bela Judíoʼmar-Damascoʼgi-mamaid egi nueganbi sunmakmalad.
Ananías anse nonigu, anga sognonikid: ‘Gwenad-Saulo, gannar mag be atak gubarsun.’ A-wachigi yog gannar atakar an naded. Geb an Ananías magar daksad.

”Ananías anga sogdebalid: ‘Anmar-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad be-susad, adi, na e-ibmar-abemaid be wisguegar, degi, Bab-Dummad dule-napiragwad-barminonigusad mag be dakegar, degine, e-gayaburba sanar be nue itobaligar.
Emide, be nue-daksadi, degi, be nue-itosbalidi, bela dulemarga be sogoed.
Emide, ¿ibu be bar abdaksunna? Be gwisgue, Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi be obnasun. Jesús-nuggi Bab-Dummadse be gorsun, adi, ulubgi be gwage-isgunaid bega eliegar.’ ”
Pablo, Judíoʼsurmaladse barmiles gusad
Pablo sogdebalid: “Jerusalénʼse an gannar nonigua, Babse-goled-negse Babse-golega an nadegusad. An nue Babse-gorsiidgine, an ibya-apurusad.
Agi Dummad-Jesús an dakalid, anga soge: ‘Gwae Jerusalénʼgi be nae, ar dulemar-weginmaladi, be angi-sunmakoedgi beba ibsaosurmalad.’

”An ega sogded: ‘Dummad-Jesús, bela dulemar an-wismalad, an dulemar esgaryase sedega Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse dulemar-begi-bensurmalad-baregindiidaed wismalad, degi, sabsuli an a-dulemar-sarsodidaed wismarbalid.
Aginbali, wismarbalid, Esteban-begi-sunmaked-oburgwenanaimargu, an gwichi gusmogad. Nabir an itogwichi gusad, degine, Esteban-oburgwenanaimalad-e-mor-gaega an gwichigusad wismarbalid.’
”Ar Dummad-Jesús anga sokalid: ‘Suli, be-itogosurmalad. Degisoggu, dikasur be nae, ar dulemar-Judíoʼsurmaladse an be-barmidoed.’ ”
Pablo, Roma-sorda-dummadse galesad
Dulemar Pablo-deyob-sogsa-itosmargu, bela itobukmalad oimakarmalad, sogdemalad: “¡We-dule be oburgwe! ¡Bar-dulagudii abelesuli!”
Ar bela binnasur oimakbukwad, na e-mor-dummad-yoyoid mie-mie imakdemalad, ukub niba mie-mie imakdemarbalid. Adi, oyogega Pablo-ibmar-soged abingasurmarye.
Geb Roma-sorda-dummad e-sordamarga sogded, neg-gandikid-yaba Pablo-odoye. Igar uksabalid bibyobaloye, adi, Pablo ega sogega, ibiga dulemar egi nue-oimakarmarye.
Ar bato Pablo-bibyogegala edinnar ganimargua, Pablo, Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid (100) e-walik-gwichidga, sogded: —¿Ar bega igar maisi, Roma-dulega igar-itossuli bibyogoye?
Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid deyob-ega-soge itosgua, e-dummadse naded, ega sogdapid: —¿Ibi be imaksokali? Nue salakar. Ar we-dule, Roma-duled.
Roma-sorda-bur-dummad Pabloʼse naded, ese egisdapid: —¿Ar wede nue-nabiri, be Roma-dule? Pablo, abin-sogded: —Eye, nabiri, an Roma-dule.
Degi, Roma-sorda-bur-dummad Pablo-abin sogded: —¿Degbali? Andi Roma-dulega-guega mani-dummad an misad. Pablo abin-sogded: —Andi bato gusgu gwalulesad-akale, Roma-dule gued.

Sordamar-Pablo-bibyosokarmaladi, degi-soge-itosmargu, egi bangudmalad. Roma-sorda-bur-dummadse-bakar, itoargu, Pablo Roma-duleye, dobe itonadmogad, ar ade, igar-maisulidba Pablo-edinnega igar-uksa gusad.
Pablo, Judíoʼmar-dummagan-asabin selesgusad

A-banedgine, Roma-sorda-bur-dummad, ar nue wisgubisoggu, ibiga Judíoʼmar Pablo-isdar-dakmala, a-ular, Pablo-esgoro-dubgi-atinnaled esiksad. Geb dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-dummaganse, degi, Judío-dummagan-igar-nabiromaladse gochasunnad, adi, Pabloʼga igar-itomalagar. Geb dummagan-abarse Pablo-ogwisnonisunnad.
